name: Four Seasons Hotel Miami
positioning: Four Seasons hotel on Brickell Avenue in Miami with a seventh-floor, two-acre pool terrace
best_for: Guests who want a poolside stay in Brickell, Miami
Guests who want an Equinox spa and fitness centre on site

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Miami opened in October 2003.
The hotel has 221 guest rooms in total.
The hotel is at 1435 Brickell Avenue in Miami, Florida.
The hotel lobby is on the seventh floor.
Hotel accommodations span the 8th to 29th floors of the building.
The seventh-floor pool terrace is a tree-lined, two-acre urban oasis set against the Miami skyline.
The hotel has ten private cabanas with dedicated service.
Edge Miami is a rooftop restaurant at Four Seasons Hotel Miami.
NUNA offers Nikkei cuisine, blending Japanese culinary techniques with the flavours of Peru.
Séptimo is an intimate rooftop cocktail bar at the hotel.
The Spa at Equinox is located on the fourth floor of the hotel.

highlights.text: Hotel guests enjoy complimentary access to Equinox, located on the fourth floor.
The Premier Bayfront Room has unobstructed views of the Biscayne Bay.
The hotel's art collection includes three oversized bronze sculptures from Colombian artist Fernando Botero.
Edge Miami serves an elevated brunch buffet on Sundays.
Sunrise Poolside Yoga is held every Saturday morning.

considerations.text: The hotel is not directly on the beach.
Daily valet parking costs USD 65 per day.
The spa is open from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm Monday to Friday.
WhataHotel notes a premium luxury pricing point.
